buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Eligibility Criteria & Documents Required Ser. No. Eligibility Criteria Documents Required 1. The bidder must have fully operational/functional office in Delhi and the details of organisational profil e, contact address, manpower details along with copy of registration certificate of the firm. Valid copy of Certificate shall be attached. 2. The bidder must have during last five year experience of having successfully completed supply of item s costing not less than Rs. 10 lakh each in Central/State Govt department. Completion certificate and Wo rk order copies shall be attached. 3. Onsite OEM services within the period of warranty and service center in Delhi with toll free numbers fo

r service. Copies of the valid Supporting documents on the support centre of the OEM. 4. If the Bidder is not an OEM, OEM's authorisation letter (with the mention of this tender details) should be furnished/uploaded to participate in the bid along with OEM Audited Balance Sheet/CA Certificate. Co pies of valid documents duly signed and stamped by OEM. 5. An undertaking certificate that the bidder has not been blacklisted by any Central/State Government i nstitutions and there has been no pending litigation with any Government department on account of exec ution of similar maintenance service should be furnished. Self-Declaration to be attached. 6. The bidder must have three years of experience in the business of primary items selling. The suitabl e/complete supportive documents in claim of their experience should be submitted/uploaded. 7. Solvency certificate issued by any Nationalized Banks for the amount of Rs. 5,00,000/-. Solvency cer tificate shall have been issued by the bank in the financial year 2023-24 or current financial year. Solvency certificate of any previous year shall not be acceptable and shall render bid non-responsive. 8. The bidder should have minimum annual turnover of Rs. 20 lakhs in the last three financial years (202 1-22, 2022-23 and 2023-24). Balance sheets, Trading and Profit & Loss Account of last three years as ab ove, to be enclosed duly attested by CA along with relevant documentary proof. 9. Certified copy of last three financial years ITR ending on 31 March 2023 along with GST Certificate and PAN card. Last three months GST Return. Documents to be attached in Technical Bids. 10. The company should be ISO 9001 certified for quality standards and ISO 27001 certified for informati on security. Copies of the certificates to be attached. Documents to be attached in Technical Bids. 11. The tender should be accompanied with bid security declaration form. Self-Declaration to be attac hed in Technical Bid. 12. After award of contract - Successful bidders shall have to get advance sample approved from buyer before bulk manufacturing/starting bulk supplies submit samples for Buyer's approval within five days of a ward of contract. Self-Declaration to be attached in Technical Bid. 13. The bidder should have adequate infrastructure and dedicated and experienced technical and skilled personnel to execute the work. Supporting documents of support staff/declaration. 14. The seller has to provide advance sample (trial sample) of each products for inspection at the stage of TEC. — 15. The warranty period of 26 months will cover the entire items supplied at buyer's location. No payme nt will be made by the buyer to the seller towards replacement etc. of the entire items during warranty per iod. — Note: 1. Whole tender document along with above documents duly signed and stamped on each page by the bid der be uploaded, in token of acceptance of terms & conditions of the contract by the bidder. 2. If the bidder is already blacklisted by any agency, buyer reserves the right to not considering the bid and disqualified. 3. The date of manufacturing of the item should not be more than a year from the date of supply order. .
